Hard copy / Digital ที่ให้เลือกหมายถึงแค่ตัว Artbook[/p][p]แบบ Special Set Digital จะยังได้แผ่นรองเม้าไปส่งที่บ้านเหมือนเดิมนะครับ ไม่ใช่ให้ไฟล์ไปทำเอง สบายใจได้ครับ ส่วน Drama CD จะไม่มีแผ่นนะครับเป็นแบบ Digital ทั้ง 2 แบบเลย[/p]

notes.title: Re:Fragment ~Absolute Ambition~ Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that our game, Re:Fragment ~Absolute Ambition~ (full version) is now available. You can grab it on Steam right now!

First and foremost, we want to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who has supported Re:Fragment ~Absolute Ambition~ since the demo release. We truly appreciate your enthusiasm and belief in our game.

We've been carefully listening to your feedback and have been working diligently to address the issues you reported. This includes fixing major bugs, such as the screen flickering problem, and adding new features based on your suggestions, like custom voice settings for each character.  

We've also had all the English text in the game retranslated. All of these changes are aimed at ensuring you have the best possible experience when playing Re:Fragment ~Absolute Ambition~.

We, AstralSeal, are a small indie game development team passionate about visual novels. We're committed to delivering the highest quality possible, even with our limited budget and resources. Now, we invite you to dive into the world of Re:Fragment ~Absolute Ambition~ and enjoy the game!

Thank you all for your continued support.

coregameHD
Scenario Writer
